# Installing the eBPF Manager Operator {#bpfman-operator-install}

To manage eBPF programs across your cluster nodes, you can install the eBPF Manager Operator by using the OpenShift Container Platform CLI or the web console. This Operator provides a standardized way to deploy, monitor, and secure eBPF-based networking and observability tools.

**Additional resources**

- [Deploying a containerized eBPF program](/networking/networking_operators/ebpf_manager/ebpf-manager-operator-deploy#bpfman-operator-deploy)
- [Configuring Ingress Node Firewall Operator to use the eBPF Manager Operator](/networking/networking_operators/ingress-node-firewall-operator#bpfman-infw-configure_ingress-node-firewall-operator)
